what: The Real plan card goes dark correctly, but the purple and teal what-if cards stay saturated light surfaces with black text, black outline chips and a black primary button, so most of the page reads as light-theme content dropped onto a dark background.
where: Compare: what-if plan cards (fork-coloured surfaces)
suggestedFix: Use a darker tint of the fork colour for the card surface in dark mode and keep the ink tokens theme-aware, as the Summary's leg chips already do.

title: Real plan shows 'Nights 0' while Summary says 34 nights; what-if deltas are computed against that 0
what: Likely data rather than layout, but very visible: the Real plan card says NIGHTS 0 (and 'Italy first' also 0) while the Summary stat for the same trip says 34. '+ Switzerland' then shows '14  +14 nights', which is nonsense relative to the real plan. A Traveller comparing plans would not trust the numbers.
where: Compare: Real plan card NIGHTS stat
suggestedFix: Check how nights are derived for the real plan on the compare page (probably reading fork-only accommodation rows).

title: Tally card stretches to map height, leaving a large empty block mid-card
what: The yellow Tally card is forced to the map card's height, so between '1 countries visited' and the 'places / nights away / km travelled' row there is 150–200px of nothing. It reads like a missing section rather than a deliberate pause, especially next to the dense Plan and Money pages.
where: Tally card (section next to the 'Your travels' map)
suggestedFix: Either align-self:start the Tally card and let the map be taller, or fill the space with a second row of stats / larger numerals so the card earns its height.

title: Tally stats cramped at 768: '947 km' breaks across two lines, 'nights away' wraps
what: At tablet width the Tally card is ~180px wide and its two-column stat grid no longer fits: '947 km' wraps to '947 / km' and 'nights away' wraps under '17'. The result is three stats of different heights with ragged underlines.
where: Tally card stat grid (9 places / 17 nights away / 947 km travelled)
suggestedFix: Stack the stats in one column below ~1000px, or use white-space:nowrap on the numeral and let the label wrap.

title: Phone stats strip uses different vocabulary and set of stats from the desktop Tally
what: On phones the strip reads '1 countries · 17 nights · 947 km been' while on desktop the same data is 'countries visited · places · nights away · km travelled' with a Planned/Been toggle. 'been' as a label is odd, '1 countries' is not pluralised, 'places' is dropped, and there is no Planned/Been switch on mobile. A Traveller moving between phone and laptop sees two different widgets for one idea.
where: Yellow stats strip under the map on phone widths
suggestedFix: Reuse the Tally component's labels and pluralisation on mobile (and consider carrying over the Planned/Been toggle).

title: On-the-road hero card says 'Day 4 of 7' twice
what: The hero card shows the big numeral '4 of 7 days' and, on the same card, the caption 'Day 4 of 7 · Nelson'. On phones they sit three lines apart; on desktop the caption sits in the header chip row and the numeral below. The repeated figure wastes the card's most prominent slot.
where: article.island (on-the-road trip card): div.mt-auto > p.mt-1 'Day 4 of 7 · Nelson' and the big-number block
suggestedFix: Keep the big '4 of 7 days' and reduce the caption to the current stop ('Nelson' or 'Now in Nelson').

title: Map markers render underneath the 'Your travels' label pill on phones
what: The cluster of markers for the Great Ocean Road trip sits directly under the 'Your travels' pill in the map's top-left, so the pill covers two or three markers and their outlines poke out beneath it. On desktop the pill and markers do not collide because the map is wider.
where: Map card: 'Your travels' label overlay vs marker layer
suggestedFix: Pad the map's fitBounds by the overlay height on small screens, or move the label to the card's bottom-left beside the attribution.

title: Wizard step pills crowd the logo and Cancel at 768
what: In the top bar the '1 Name' pill butts right up against the teepee wordmark's full stop and the 'Cancel' button is flush with the right edge with no breathing room. At 1024+ the same pills are centred with clear gaps on both sides.
where: New-trip top bar: step pills (Name / When / From / Cover) and Cancel
suggestedFix: Below ~900px drop the step labels to numbers-only pills, or move the stepper under the logo row.

title: 'Fills in as you answer' caption is nearly invisible in dark theme
what: Under the preview card the caption is rendered in a dark grey that almost matches the dotted dark background; in the light theme it is a clearly readable muted ink. The caption colour is not remapped for dark.
where: Preview pane caption under the trip-card preview
suggestedFix: Use the muted-foreground token that already works on the Account page's helper text in dark mode.

title: Empty-state headings inconsistent: 'No devices yet' vs 'Nothing is connected yet.'
what: The Devices and Connected apps cards use the same dashed empty-state tile side by side, but one heading has a full stop and the other does not, and their sub-lines differ in tone ('No device is set up yet.' vs 'Add Teepee in your Claude app and sign in to connect it.'). On phones 'Nothing is connected yet.' also wraps to two lines while its neighbour stays on one.
where: Account: Devices and Connected apps empty-state tiles
suggestedFix: Match the pattern: short heading without a full stop, one-sentence helper underneath, both drawn from the same empty-state component.

title: Feedback sheet mixes left-aligned title with a centred empty-state line
what: 'Feedback' and 'You're on Trips' are left-aligned, then 'No feedback yet. Tell me what's annoying.' is centred, then the textarea and Send are left/right aligned. The lone centred line looks misplaced, and it has no spacing distinction from the title block.
where: Feedback sheet: empty-state line above the textarea
suggestedFix: Left-align the empty-state line and give it the muted helper style used under form fields.

title: Wishlist map zoom control stays light-theme in dark mode; Globe's is themed
what: In dark theme the Globe page's Leaflet +/- control is restyled to the dark surface with light glyphs, but the Wishlist map keeps Leaflet's default white box with black glyphs. The two maps sit a tap apart (Add from Globe) and look like different apps. The Leaflet attribution strip is likewise white on the Wishlist map but that is partly tile-related.
where: Wishlist Map view .leaflet-control-zoom inside the map card
suggestedFix: Apply the same themed zoom-control styles used on the Globe map to the Wishlist map (share one map wrapper/stylesheet).

title: Phone header stacks a lone 'Add from Globe' button, then a lone right-aligned List/Map toggle
what: After the title row, the phone layout puts 'Add from Globe' alone on the left, then a full-width empty row with the List/Map segmented control pushed to the right, before the content starts. Two orphaned controls on consecutive rows with large gaps read as leftover space, and 'Add an idea' (the primary action on desktop) is not in this header at all on phones.
where: Wishlist page header: the Add from Globe button row and the List/Map toggle row below it
suggestedFix: Put Add from Globe and the List/Map toggle on one row (space-between), or move the toggle next to the title, and consider surfacing the primary Add an idea action in the same group on phones.

title: Sidebar 'Back to' trip name truncates ('Great Ocean R...') with no title/tooltip
what: The sidebar's Back to card clips the trip name to 'Great Ocean R...' at every desktop width and exposes no title, aria-label or tooltip, so a hover or screen reader cannot recover 'Great Ocean Road, right now'. This is global chrome, so it likely shows on every page reached from a trip.
where: [data-testid="sidebar"] a.flex:nth-of-type(1) > span.flex:nth-of-type(2) > span.truncate:nth-of-type(2)
suggestedFix: Add title={tripName} (and aria-label on the link) to the truncated span, or allow two lines for the name in the Back to card.

title: Add Item dialog: Category chip row orphans 'Other' alone on a second line
what: In the desktop Add Item dialog the eight category chips fit seven on the first line and leave 'Other' orphaned on its own line below. At 360 the row wraps 3/3/2 and at 390 4/4, which look intentional; the desktop orphan looks accidental. Marker-add uses a select for the same field, so the two 'add' forms also present Category differently.
where: Add Item dialog, Category chip group (div with the Sightseeing...Other buttons)
suggestedFix: Tighten chip padding or the dialog's inner width so all eight fit, or deliberately balance to two rows of four at sm+.
